findings.summary: The new operation keeps existing due dates unchanged, but the revised S.webapp.due requires every open goal's due date to be recomputed in the new zone.
findings.evidence: S.webapp.due: "When the owner changes time zone, every open goal's due date must be recomputed in the new zone." vs operation.account.setTimeZone effects: "Keep existing due dates unchanged, Goals saved afterwards use the new zone"

findings.summary: Neither the operation nor the journey recomputes goals, suggestions or jobs, so the journey's goal of keeping due dates right is never achieved.
findings.evidence: operation.account.setTimeZone links: only "writes entity.Account"; t3: "Update the owner's time zone" -> e1 "Settings show the new time zone"; actorGoal: "Keep due dates right after moving to another time zone"

findings.summary: The operation lists a stale-version conflict, but entity.Account has no version field to check against.
findings.evidence: failure: "Stale version returns conflict"; entity.Account fields: id, identitySubject, displayName, timeZone, notificationPreferences
